description: This file contains mock class definitions for testing the Cellular State Machine (cellular_sm), including interfaces for thread operations and cellular hardware interactions, with associated mock implementations using Google Mock.

classes.name: SMPThreadInterface
classes.description: An interface class defining virtual methods for thread and cellular hardware interactions, intended to be mocked in unit tests.

classes.name: SMPThreadMock
classes.description: A Google Mock implementation of the SMPThreadInterface for unit testing purposes.

methods.name: pthreads_create
methods.description: Creates a new thread, replicating the pthread_create function.

methods.name: CellularMgrUpdateLinkStatus
methods.description: Updates the link status with provided parameters.

methods.name: CellularMgr_Util_SendIPToWanMgr
methods.description: Sends IP information to the WAN manager.

methods.name: CellularMgrUpdatePhyStatus
methods.description: Updates the physical status of the cellular device.

methods.name: CellularMgr_RBUS_Events_PublishInterfaceStatus
methods.description: Publishes the interface status over RBUS events.

methods.name: CellularMgr_RBUS_Events_PublishPhyConnectionStatus
methods.description: Publishes physical connection status over RBUS events.

methods.name: CellularMgr_RBUS_Events_PublishLinkAvailableStatus
methods.description: Publishes link availability status over RBUS events.

methods.name: cellular_hal_IsModemDevicePresent
methods.description: Checks if a modem device is present.

methods.name: cellular_hal_select_device_slot
methods.description: Selects the device slot for cellular hardware.

methods.name: CellularMgr_GetActiveCardStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the active SIM card.

methods.name: cellular_hal_start_network
methods.description: Starts a network with specified parameters.
